paper_metadata.title: Libra: Building Decoupled Vision System on Large Language Models
paper_metadata.abstract: In this work, we introduce Libra, a prototype model with a decoupled vision system on a large language model (LLM). The decoupled vision system decouples inner-modal modeling and cross-modal interaction, yielding unique visual information modeling and effective cross-modal comprehension. Libra is trained through discrete auto-regressive modeling on both vision and language inputs. Specifically, we incorporate a routed visual expert with a cross-modal bridge module into a pretrained LLM to route the vision and language flows during attention computing to enable different attention patterns in inner-modal modeling and cross-modal interaction scenarios. Experimental results demonstrate that the dedicated design of Libra achieves a strong MLLM baseline that rivals existing works in the image-to-text scenario with merely 50 million training data, providing a new perspective for future multimodal foundation models. Code is available at https://github.com/YifanXu74/Libra.

extraction_data.innovation: Decoupled vision system design that separates inner-modal modeling from cross-modal interaction; incorporates a routed visual expert and cross-modal bridge module to route vision and language flows during attention computing, enabling distinct attention patterns for inner-modal and cross-modal scenarios.
extraction_data.pretraining_task: Discrete auto-regressive modeling on vision and language inputs
extraction_data.finetuning_task: Multimodal instruction tuning, Instruction tuning / Supervised finetuning (SFT)
extraction_data.extension: Uses lookup-free quantization (LFQ) with a CLIP-based VQGAN to tokenize images into two codebooks of size 2^9, reducing prediction head parameters to 4M while maintaining high reconstruction quality and preserving CLIP knowledge.
extraction_data.research_problem: Building an effective vision system for LLMs that retains extensive visual understanding while facilitating cross-modal comprehension, addressing the information imbalance in unified multimodal models.
extraction_data.application: Image-to-text generation, multimodal conversation, visual understanding
extraction_data.paper_title: Libra: Building Decoupled Vision System on Large Language Models
extraction_data.tokenizer: CLIP-based image tokenizer using lookup-free quantization (LFQ)
extraction_data.hardware_description: 8400 GPU hours for multimodal pretraining, 380 GPU hours for SFT on NVIDIA A100-40G
extraction_data.attention_mechanism: Novel attention computing mechanism for routed visual experts, Diverse attention patterns across all layers

extraction_data.fusion_architecture: Decoupled (routed visual expert + cross-modal bridge module)
